name: Son-Vidéo.com
description: French online retailer of hi-fi, home cinema, speakers, televisions, projectors, headphones, vinyl, cables and connected-home products. Its delivery FAQ says it delivers across French territory including most DOM-TOM products, with free delivery to its shops in France.
description_es: Tienda online francesa de alta fidelidad, cine en casa, altavoces, televisores, proyectores, auriculares, vinilos, cables y productos para el hogar conectado. Su FAQ de entrega indica que entrega en todo el territorio francés, incluidos la mayoría de los productos en los DOM-TOM, y que la entrega en sus tiendas de Francia es gratuita.

ships_to.notes: Delivery FAQ states delivery across French territory including DOM-TOM for most products; some carrier services exclude Corsica.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Delivery FAQ offers free delivery to a shop anywhere in France; homepage mentions 18 shops in France.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Delivery FAQ also says it ships across Europe and to Switzerland, and outside Europe on request. Chronopost on appointment and Mondial Relay exclude Corsica.

sources.supports: delivery areas, Corsica exclusions and free delivery to shops
